tagline.az: Stomatoloji klinika və öz diş laboratoriyası
tagline.ru: Стоматологическая клиника со своей зуботехнической лабораторией
tagline.en: Dental clinic with its own dental laboratory

intro.az: Bəyaz Diş — terapiya, cərrahiyyə, implantasiya, protezləmə, ortodontiya və uşaq stomatologiyası bir ünvanda. Onlayn yazılın — administrator vaxtı təsdiqləmək üçün sizinlə əlaqə saxlayacaq.
intro.ru: Bəyaz Diş — терапия, хирургия, имплантация, протезирование, ортодонтия и детская стоматология по одному адресу. Запишитесь онлайн — администратор свяжется с вами, чтобы подтвердить время.
intro.en: Bəyaz Diş offers general, surgical, implant, prosthetic, orthodontic and children's dentistry in one place. Book online and our administrator will contact you to confirm the time.

map.query: Bəyaz Diş Klinikası, Həsənoğlu küçəsi 12c, Bakı

items.author: Fatima K.
items.text:
Staff was very professional.
Dr. Orkhan did great job!
Highly recommended.

items.author: Mansha D.
items.text:
My husband's mouth protese broke and we came to the Beyaz Dis clinic who gave excellent assistance.
The staff received us with big smiles and solved our problem.
We are very happy and will recommend the clinicb

items.author: Amin T.
items.text: I was deeply impressed with the comfort that I felt during my operation, which I had the pleasure of undergoing at Dr Orhan Novruzov’s dental office. Dr Novruzov’s tranquil nature coupled with utmost professionalism made me feel totally relaxed. As a result, I again chew with my teeth and feel like I am seventeen again! Thank you, Doctor!

text.ru: Клиника и лаборатория — под одной крышей.
text.en: The clinic and the laboratory are under one roof.

text.az: Cərrahi və implant prosedurları klinikanın öz əməliyyat otağında aparılır.
text.ru: Хирургические и имплантологические процедуры — в собственной операционной клиники.
text.en: Surgical and implant procedures take place in the clinic's own operating room.
696 reviews and a 4.9 rating on Google.

text.az: Bir dəqiqəyə onlayn yazılın və qəbuldan bir gün əvvəl WhatsApp-da xatırlatma alın.
text.ru: Запишитесь онлайн за минуту и получите напоминание в WhatsApp за день до приёма.
text.en: Book online in a minute and get a WhatsApp reminder the day before your visit.

name.note: Google Maps: 'Bəyaz Diş Klinikası (Official)'; 2GIS: 'Bəyaz Diş, stomatoloji klinika və laboratoriya'.

address.note: Shown: Həsənoğlu 12c (2GIS). The ministry's partner-clinic list gives 15A; the (indexed) site says 'Fatali Khan Khoyski / Khasanoglu'. Confirm on the Google listing.

phones.note: 010 511 08 01 is the number on the Google listing (seen 2026-10-23) and the indexed site. (+994 12) 310 40 33 is from the ministry's partner-clinic list only.

instagram.note: A directory links an 'official' Instagram, but the handle was not visible.

website.note: No working website: the agency checked on 2026-10-23. Search engines still index pages of beyazdis.az (services, doctors), so the domain may have lapsed — a strong talking point.

hours.note: Mon–Sat 09:00–19:00 from the indexed site; Sunday not stated — confirm.

services.note: Service lines from the indexed site; consultation shown as a placeholder. Whitening: mentioned in the Google review summary (seen 2026-10-23).

doctors.note: Names and specialties from the indexed doctors page. Dr. Orkhan Novruzov is also named in two Google reviews. The Google review summary also thanks 'Dr. Nijat' (and a 'Dr. Ramiz' and 'İlahə doktor', not yet listed).

rating.note: 4.9 from 696 reviews on the clinic's Google Maps listing (seen 2026-10-23; screenshot supplied by the agency). Earlier copies elsewhere showed 629.

map.note: Search link built from the clinic name and street.

brandColor.note: Our choice; the clinic's logo and photos were not copied.

reviews.note: 3 reviews copied word for word (original language, not Google's translation) from the clinic's Google Maps listing on 2026-10-23 (screenshots supplied by the agency); names shortened to first name + surname initial. Relative dates as of that day. For the demo only; switch to the live Google feed or get the clinic's OK before going public.
